name: finishes-simple
description: Simple ladder for finishes: verify the finish picker (FinishPicker) opens when a room is selected in the room editor, apply a floor finish and a wall finish, and assert the store records the change. Simple-vs-Pro tier check: finishDnd is simple-tier and must be ON in Simple mode.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-finishdnd-on-in-simple
steps.failMessage: finishDnd should be ON in Simple mode (it is simple-tier)

steps.name: finish-picker-visible
steps.failMessage: FinishPicker (.panel.inspector) did not appear after room selection

steps.name: verify-floor-finish-stored
steps.failMessage: Floor finish 'floor-wood-oak' was not persisted to state.finishes.floor

steps.name: verify-wall-finish-stored
steps.failMessage: Wall finish 'wall-paint-white' was not persisted to state.finishes.walls

steps.name: verify-picker-still-visible
